== 2008 MPC result and source dates ==

Added third place in Saturday's consolation from the complete numbered standings.<ref>[https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewtopic.php?t=18352#p255191 Saturday consolation results], Advocate, Players Committee Forums (10 January 2008).</ref>

The 2011 Worlds Day 2 row now cites the actual named deck sheets, pages 47–48 of [[:File:2011 Worlds Day 2.pdf]]. Both give the event date as 13 August 2011. The old forum category returned a login page when checked.

The prior service date values were:

* Red 87: "November 1999 – January 2001".
* PC Store Manager: "8 July 2021 – Present".
* Tournament Committee member: "8 July 2021".
* Social Media Team member: "6 May 2024 – Present".

These date cells were cleared while retaining the roles and references. The checked Coruscant roster names Chris Gogolen as Red 87 in New Brunswick, NJ; its capture date does not establish his term of service.<ref>[https://web.archive.org/web/20010115091600/http://www.decipher.com/volunteers/squadrons/regions/coruscant.html Star Wars CCG Squadrons: Coruscant], Decipher (Internet Archive capture, 15 January 2001).</ref> The organization-chart references describe 8 July 2021 and 6 May 2024 as PDF creation dates, which do not establish appointments or complete service terms. Artifact dates remain in the citations; the earlier article values and source locators are preserved in the prior revision and batch evidence.
